summary_en: Mitsubishi Kakoki raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 9 yen to 69 yen per share, adding a 6 yen commemorative dividend to mark the management integration with Tsukishima Holdings signed on September 30, 2026. Total FY2027 annual dividend is now 135 yen per share, up from the previous forecast of 120 yen.
title_en: Announcement Regarding Dividend Forecast (Year-End Dividend and Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Mitsubishi Kakoki announced an upward revision of its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast. The ordinary year-end dividend was increased by 9 yen to 69 yen per share from the previous forecast of 60 yen. In addition, the company declared a commemorative dividend of 6 yen per share to mark the execution of the management integration agreement with Tsukishima Holdings on September 30, 2026.

Combining the revised ordinary dividend of 69 yen and the commemorative dividend of 6 yen, the total year-end dividend for FY2027 is 75 yen per share. This increases the total full-year dividend for FY2027 to 135 yen per share, compared to the previous forecast of 120 yen and the prior fiscal year's result of 115 yen per share.

The revision reflects the company's Q2 consolidated business performance disclosed in the earnings announcement on the same date and its medium-term management plan for FY2025-FY2027, which emphasizes shareholder returns as the highest priority policy. The company maintains its basic dividend policy of achieving long-term stable management and enriched internal reserves while distributing profits.
